question_text: WATER is to THIRST as FOOD is to ___?

hint_ladder.title: Relasyon: Remedyo-Prob
hint_ladder.text: Tubig ay panlaban sa uhaw. Ang pattern ay 'remedy : problem'. Ano ang problemang sinosolve ng pagkain?

hint_ladder.title: Gutom ang sagot
hint_ladder.text: Pagkain ay sagot sa gutom. Parallel lang: WATER : THIRST, FOOD : HUNGER. Isipin mo laging basic need.

hint_ladder.title: Distractor Check
hint_ladder.text: I-check ang choices: Taste (sensory lang), Cook (aksyon), Eat (aksyon). Wala silang 'problem' na niremedyuhan. Hunger lang ang tugma.

hint_ladder.title: Final Answer
hint_ladder.text: Tamang sagot: Hunger. Kumpirmado: Tubig–Uhaw :: Pagkain–Gutom. Remedyo sa problema, basic survival needs.

A.text: Correct. Food satisfies hunger, just as water quenches thirst—the remedy-to-problem relationship holds.

B.text: You might have chosen B because 'Taste' is associated with food, but it’s not the problem that food solves; it’s a sensory quality.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 'Cook' relates to food preparation, but the analogy asks for the need, not an action.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'Eat' is the act of consuming food, but the analogy requires the need that food remedies.

next_time_rule: Kapag analogy, hanapin ang 'remedy : problem' pattern. Tubig sa uhaw; pagkain sa gutom. Alalahanin ang basic need.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo sa local na scenario: mainit na araw sa palengke, bumili ka ng ice-cold buko juice—ayun, panlaban sa uhaw. Parang ganyan din ang pagkain: kapag gutom ka, hahanap ka ng kanin at ulam. Pareho silang remedyo sa problema.

Kaya sa analogy, WATER:THIRST ay remedy:problem. FOOD:HUNGER din. Ang choices na Taste, Cook, Eat—mga katangian o aksyon lang 'yan, hindi ang core need. Kaya A ang sagot.
